# UK Brand LOVER — Authentic UK Beauty Flagship Bangladesh

> UK Brand LOVER is Bangladesh's premier verified retailer of 100% authentic UK-imported skincare, haircare, and cosmetics. Every customer order includes the original UK physical store purchase receipt (Boots UK, Superdrug, direct brand flagships) and verifiable batch codes. Direct London air shipment ensures fresh formulation and zero counterfeit risk.

## Quick Facts
- **Store Name**: UK Brand LOVER
- **Primary Market**: Bangladesh (Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Khulna, Barisal, Rangpur, Mymensingh)
- **Authenticity Policy**: 100% Money-Back Authenticity Guarantee with original UK store purchase receipts.
- **Delivery**: Dhaka 24–48 hours (৳80 BDT), Nationwide 48–72 hours (৳160 BDT).
